content.short: BlackRock BUIDL is a tokenized money market fund that brings U.S. Treasury yields and 24/7 liquidity on-chain.
content.description:
The BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund (BUIDL) is a pioneering tokenized fund that bridges traditional finance with blockchain technology. Available on major networks like Ethereum and Solana, BUIDL invests in cash, U.S. Treasury bills, and repurchase agreements, maintaining a stable value of $1.00 per token. It offers institutional investors a way to earn daily accrued dividends, which are distributed monthly as new tokens directly to their digital wallets, combining the safety of traditional assets with the efficiency of Web3.

By utilizing the Securitize platform for tokenization and BNY Mellon as a custodian, BUIDL ensures a high level of institutional-grade security and transparency. The fund enables instantaneous, 24/7/365 transfers and settlements, bypassing the limitations of traditional banking hours. As one of the first major institutional products in the RWA space, BlackRock BUIDL is a critical milestone in the mainstream adoption of tokenized assets and decentralized liquidity solutions.
